notes_sections.heading: Search limitations — documented retrieval method still broken, refined workaround
items: The SKILL.md-documented URL pattern https://www.roberthalf.com/ca/en/jobs?jobType=CONTRACT&specialty=TECHNOLOGY&keywords=<term> is still not tested as a revival candidate this run since the working UI-driven method (see below) is already reliable and faster to execute manually; no evidence it has been fixed.

Working method used this run: submit each keyword through the on-page search box (redirects to https://www.roberthalf.com/ca/en/jobs/all/<keyword-slug>), then open the page's own Job Type filter chip. When Contract / Temporary to Hire appears as an option, select it and apply — this reliably scopes to contract-only postings client-side. When the chip only offers Permanent/Temporary (no Contract/Temporary to Hire option at all), that keyword has zero contract results and is recorded as such without reviewing the Permanent/Temporary noise.
This is a skill-maintenance item: .agents/skills/check-roberthalf/SKILL.md's Access section already documents this UI workaround as of the 2026-09-21 run; no further edit needed.

rows.title: Senior Director Engineering
rows.location: Toronto, ON — on-site/hybrid implied ("local engineering presence," "represent the Toronto development centre")
rows.gap: Toronto is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal) — hard geography gate on its own. Separately, the role requires formal budget and headcount ownership across engineering/QA/DevOps/SRE functions (10+ years progressive engineering leadership) — a genuine mismatch against Marc's 'leads without authority' positioning, which has the substance of cross-team technical leadership but no formal management title, tenure, or P&L/headcount authority at director scale.
